plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked bar chart from Marie Curie's 12 April 1898 Academy note compares the piezoelectric quartz electrometer currents: Metallic Uranium = 24 picocoulombs/s (24 × 10⁻¹² A), Natural Chalcolite = 52 picocoulombs/s (~2× uranium), and Joachimsthal Pitchblende ore = 83 picocoulombs/s (~3.5–4× uranium).

teach_overlay.label: URANIUM 24 PA · CHALCOLITE 52 PA · PITCHBLENDE 83 PA (~4×)

teach_overlay.scale: 83 trillionths of an ampere — an electric current a hundred billion times smaller than a household lightbulb, measured with a stretched crystal of quartz and a stopwatch
